modules.name: studio_service.py
modules.purpose: Owns persisted projects, chapter jobs and the ordered story-to-video stages.

modules.name: studio_data.py
modules.purpose: Validates project schemas, narration, chapters, canonical character identity and mutable appearance.

modules.name: director_provider.py
modules.purpose: Validates focused planning passes and canonical facts; adapters remain replaceable.

modules.name: openai_director.py
modules.purpose: Prepares bounded context, structured requests, retries, token accounting and optional vision reviews.

modules.name: economy_studio.py
modules.purpose: Controls context size, planning budgets and generation modes without substituting story facts.

modules.name: prompt_quality.py
modules.purpose: Formats structured shot facts for FLUX; preserves references, appearance and important objects.

modules.name: prompt_preflight.py
modules.purpose: Checks prompt completeness and structured story constraints before paid inference.

modules.name: flux_workflow.py
modules.purpose: Builds the pinned model-specific graph and binds supported inputs.

modules.name: qwen_workflow.py
modules.purpose: Optional Qwen image workflow adapter; not used in these Klein GPU tests.

modules.name: image_provider.py
modules.purpose: Validates capabilities, resolves workflow inputs, uploads references, submits once, awaits known IDs, retrieves and decodes outputs.

modules.name: image_engine.py
modules.purpose: Local SD fallback retained for compatibility; not used in cloud-only benchmark.

modules.name: image_queue.py
modules.purpose: Keeps legacy image queue jobs and controls; current Studio orchestration is a separate owner.

modules.name: panel_batch.py
modules.purpose: Optional multiple-panel strategy; not measured or enabled by this test.

modules.name: studio_execution.py
modules.purpose: Records ownership, cancellation, accepted remote IDs and restart reconciliation.

modules.name: studio_overlap.py
modules.purpose: Coordinates bounded image admission, shared API slots, directing, review and teardown.

modules.name: studio_qc.py
modules.purpose: Reviews expected story appearance and bounded repairs; technical decoding remains required when vision is off.

modules.name: production_trace.py
modules.purpose: Stores measured parent and nested spans in a local SQLite trace.

modules.name: queue_estimates.py
modules.purpose: Uses measured timings and job state for progress and ETA.

modules.name: narration_audio.py
modules.purpose: Handles pronunciation, stretched cries, sound effects, PCM seams, continuous chapter audio and encoding.

modules.name: studio_render.py
modules.purpose: Builds cover-framed motion clips, transitions, chapter muxes, intro and full-story assembly.

modules.name: render_queue.py
modules.purpose: Owns bounded chapter rendering, durable state, retries and shutdown.

modules.name: studio_branding.py
modules.purpose: Applies configured watermark/branding only when requested.

modules.name: server.py
modules.purpose: Routes Audio and Studio, private credentials, authenticated assets and background jobs.

modules.name: cost_control.py
modules.purpose: Checks explicit budget limits and accumulates receipts before paid work.
